# Molar

> Molar is a beta browser automation and QA platform for web applications. Its QA workflows test customer journeys in a real browser; its platform also supports scoped browser tasks for people and AI agents.

This map is generated from crawlable canonical HTML pages. Product availability and coverage depend on the configured environment; the linked pages are the source of truth.

## Start here
- [Molar — AI QA for Web Apps & Third-Party Integrations](https://molar.it/) — AI agents that test your web app like a customer. Verify signup, payments, email and the services behind every click with Molar.

## Platform
- [Molar Platform — Browser Execution for Humans & AI Agents](https://molar.it/platform) — Give your team and AI agents a browser that gets work done. Automate tasks, explore apps, extract data and inspect the result with Molar.
- [Browser agents | Molar](https://molar.it/platform/browser-agents) — Give people and coding agents a browser that can navigate, act, and verify clear goals.
- [Developer tools | Molar](https://molar.it/platform/developer-tools) — Connect browser verification and automation to CLI, MCP, JSON output, and Playwright workflows.
- [Live view | Molar](https://molar.it/platform/live-view) — Follow supported browser runs with live status and captured run files.
- [Swarm | Molar](https://molar.it/platform/swarm) — Preview coordinated browser testing across roles and scenarios with planned coverage and returned results.

## Products
- [Cartographer | Molar](https://molar.it/products/cartographer) — Give Cartographer an authorized app and a goal such as “sign up, enter the email code, and open the workspace.” It follows the route, returns the pages and browser actions it reached, and gives you a check to review or rerun.
- [Clones | Molar](https://molar.it/products/clones) — Point your test environment at a documented clone, run the payment, message, sign-in, or upload task, and inspect the record your app creates. Control supported failures and timing, then restore the starting state for the next run.
- [Guard | Molar](https://molar.it/products/guard) — Select a signup, checkout, or account-access scenario and its preview or live target. Guard reports which checks passed and which failed. Open a failure to inspect the captured browser step before deciding to ship.
- [Mender | Molar](https://molar.it/products/mender) — Review a proposed repair beside the failed browser check that prompted it.
- [Trace | Molar](https://molar.it/products/trace) — Open one run and follow its browser action, page, request, console message, and available service detail in sequence. See the failed request beside the browser step that triggered it, then share the run with the engineer fixing it.

- [Web data extraction | Molar](https://molar.it/solutions/web-data-extraction) — Read selected fields from an authorized web application through a real browser.
- [Workflow automation | Molar](https://molar.it/solutions/workflow-automation) — Run repeat browser tasks such as forms, downloads, extraction, and page checks with clear access.

## Comparisons
- [Molar Guard vs Checkly | Molar](https://molar.it/vs/checkly) — Compare Checkly monitoring and CI workflows with Molar Guard’s configured release checks and supported service-test setup.
- [Molar vs Cypress | Molar](https://molar.it/vs/cypress) — Compare Molar browser tasks and service clones with the Cypress testing workflow, without replacing tests your team already relies on.
- [Molar vs Playwright | Molar](https://molar.it/vs/playwright) — How Molar browser agents fit alongside Playwright tests, and what to check before adding generated tests to your release process.
- [Molar Trace vs Playwright Trace Viewer | Molar](https://molar.it/vs/playwright-trace) — Compare Playwright Trace Viewer with Molar Trace for inspecting browser actions, screenshots, requests, and failed checks.
- [Molar Clones vs WireMock | Molar](https://molar.it/vs/wiremock) — Compare configurable API mocks with Molar’s supported service clones: setup, state, failure cases, and the limits to check before choosing.

## Interpretation
The interactive examples on the marketing site are labeled examples or controlled tests. They are not customer testimonials, reliability benchmarks, or guarantees of complete vendor parity. Read the relevant page and documentation before relying on a capability.
